parameters.description: Only current readings, history or forecasts.
parameters.name: mode

data_type.description: The kind of data asked for, or any.

api_url.description: The dataset's address in GeoSphere's API.

endpoint.description: Its kind, time and id together, as 'Get dataset details' takes it, such as station/historical/klima-v2-1d.

formats.description: The formats GeoSphere offers it in.

frequency.description: How often it has a value, such as daily.

id.description: The dataset's id, such as klima-v2-1d.

name.description: What the dataset holds, in words.

older_version.description: Whether a newer version or a replacement has superseded it.

page_url.description: The dataset's page on GeoSphere's Data Hub.

resolution.description: The spacing of its grid, such as 1 km grid.

type.description: station (measurements at stations), timeseries (values at any place) or grid (values over an area).

use_with.description: The Lodol step that reads this dataset; null for grids, which are read through the same dataset's time series.

mode.description: The time asked for (current, historical, forecast) or any.

description: Weather and climate data from GeoSphere Austria, Austria's national weather service (formerly ZAMG). Get the latest readings from about 280 weather stations every 10 minutes, hourly forecasts and a 3-hour nowcast for any place in and around Austria, air quality forecasts, the official weather warnings, daily weather history at stations and at any place since 1961, and any of GeoSphere's station, climate and model datasets. No account or API key required.
